annotations.text:
Heads up: the landing page artboards below predate several shipped changes.

The live site now has a sector strip (Government, Construction, Manufacturing, Real estate) instead of client logo slots, no testimonial section, no phone line, and an ABN in the footer. Contact details and the booking link are all real.

The built site is authoritative, not these artboards. Ask me to sync them if you want to keep designing from here.

The social share card, exactly 1200x630. The site serves this as public/og.png, rendered from the same design by `npm run og` — so if you edit this artboard, re-run that script to regenerate the file the site actually uses.
